_doc: make_world.py's mountain exceptions (M11_MAP.md, 山地). regions: inside each polygon ([lat, lon]) the relief ramp of mountain_mask is 'ramp' instead of the one by base elevation (low ground 25-300 m, plateaus 80-450 m), blended out over feather_hexes. flat_lowland: hexes at most max_elev metres high whose own relief is at most max_relief metres are never mountains.
